definition.en: An infectious respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus.

explanation.en: Clinical severity ranges from mild illness to severe respiratory and systemic disease.

definition.en: A mosquito-borne viral infection that can cause fever, headache, body aches, and rash.

explanation.en: Some cases become severe and can affect circulation or bleeding.

definition.en: An elevation of body temperature that commonly occurs as part of an immune response.

explanation.en: Fever is a sign rather than a disease and can occur with infections and many noninfectious conditions.

definition.en: An organism from the fungal kingdom, including yeasts and molds.

explanation.en: Educational terminology entry. Related Clinical Reference and Anatomy modules can provide additional study context.

definition.en: Invasion and multiplication of microorganisms in body tissues, with or without symptoms.

explanation.en: Infections can be caused by several types of microorganisms and may be local or systemic.

definition.en: A clinical syndrome commonly associated with Epstein–Barr virus infection.

explanation.en: This is a high-level educational reference entry. Use the Clinical Reference workspace for related context; no individualized diagnosis or treatment guidance is provided.

definition.en: A contagious respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses.

explanation.en: Influenza often causes sudden fever, cough, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue.

definition.en: An infectious disease caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by certain mosquitoes.

explanation.en: Malaria commonly causes episodes of fever and systemic illness and can become severe.

definition.en: A highly contagious viral illness characterized by fever, respiratory symptoms, and a widespread rash.

explanation.en: Measles can cause serious complications, especially in vulnerable people.

definition.en: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord.

explanation.en: Meningitis may have infectious or noninfectious causes and can be medically urgent.

definition.en: An organism that lives on or in a host and obtains resources from it.

explanation.en: Educational terminology entry. Related Clinical Reference and Anatomy modules can provide additional study context.

definition.en: A microorganism or other agent capable of causing disease.

explanation.en: Educational terminology entry. Related Clinical Reference and Anatomy modules can provide additional study context.

definition.en: A life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated response to infection.

explanation.en: Sepsis is a medical emergency because circulation and organ function can deteriorate rapidly.

definition.en: An infectious disease caused by bacteria in the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, most often affecting the lungs.

explanation.en: Tuberculosis can also affect other organs and may remain latent before becoming active.

definition.en: A small infectious agent that replicates using host-cell machinery.
